newsitem.title: USA: ShopKo arranges $200 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: ShopKo arranges $200 mln credit facility.

text.p: ShopKo Stores Inc, a specialty discount retailer, said Wednesday it arranged a $200 million unsecured revolving credit facility with a group of 11 lenders.

The facility, effective through January 31, 2002, replaces a $125 million facility, which was scheduled to expire on October 4, 1997. Terms of the new agreement are nearly the same as those of the previous one.
ShopKo, which operating a chain of 130 discount stores in 15 states, said it planned to use the proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes.
ShopKo shares were up 5/8 at 27 early Wednesday afternoon.
